Print a shell completion script

Print a completion script for a shell to stdout.

bash (needs the bash-completion package):
```
source <(rp completion bash)                          # this session
rp completion bash > /etc/bash_completion.d/rp        # all sessions (Linux)
```

zsh:
```
rp completion zsh > "${fpath[1]}/_rp"                 # then start a new shell
```

fish:
```
rp completion fish > ~/.config/fish/completions/rp.fish
```

powershell:
```
rp completion powershell | Out-String | Invoke-Expression
```

```
rp completion <bash|zsh|fish|powershell>
```
